chapter: Tatum, Wiggins and Los Angeles friends
title: Jammin' the Blues
summary: He lists the musicians in the Gjon Mili film short.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Well, in the early 1940's, maybe 1942 or 1944, I don't remember which, we did Jammin' the Blues. Gjon Mili produced this. This was another thing that Norman, I guess, was co-producer on. On this was Billie Holiday, John Simmons, Jo Jones, Sweets Edison, Lester Young, Marlowe Morris was the piano player, and I played bass, too. And that won some sort of an award. It's still around.
It's a classic film. I've seen it. I'd forgotten who was on piano.
